correctness.rationale: On normalized unweighted harmonic Bergman disk, T_{z^p} on z^j is z^{p+j} and on anti-analytic zbar^n has the two explicit projected branches. For monomial p<q the commutator maps only anti-analytic basis to analytic output on k+n=p+q, nonzero except the possible central k=n. Polynomial-pencil elimination picks distinct pivot degrees r>s and isolates a nonzero top anti-diagonal; skew-symmetry for B(h,k)=int hk dA yields even rank, proving rank=2 floor((r+s-1)/2)=2 floor(deg centered Wronskian/2). W=0 iff affine dependent, giving zero, and analytic range plus analytic annihilation implies C^2=0. An independent exact-rational monomial composition/rank check for (1,2),(1,3),(2,3),(2,6),(4,7) and the weighted skew identity matched; finite checks are not full proof.
